records.text: Caroline and Melanie are friends who greeted each other warmly on 2023-05-08.
Melanie is swamped with her children and work as of 2023-05-08.
Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group on 2023-05-07.
Caroline found the LGBTQ support group that Caroline attended on 2023-05-07 to be powerful.
Caroline found the transgender stories at the LGBTQ support group inspiring.
Caroline felt happy and thankful for the support Caroline received at the LGBTQ support group.
Caroline shared a photo of a dog walking past a wall with a painting of a woman during Caroline's conversation with Melanie on 2023-05-08.
Melanie loved the painting of a woman in the photo that Caroline shared on 2023-05-08.
Melanie thinks the LGBTQ support group Caroline found is helpful.
Caroline said the LGBTQ support group made Caroline feel accepted and gave Caroline courage to embrace herself.
Melanie thinks Caroline has guts.
Caroline plans to continue her education and check out career options.
Caroline is keen on counseling or working in mental health.
Caroline would love to support people with issues similar to her own in her career.
Melanie thinks Caroline would be a great counselor and that Caroline's empathy and understanding will really help the people Caroline works with.

Caroline asked Melanie if the painting of a sunset over a lake was Melanie's own painting.
Caroline thanked Melanie and called her sweet on 2023-05-08.
On 2023-05-08 at 1:56 pm, Melanie answered Caroline by saying she painted the lake sunrise painting last year, and that it is special to her.
Melanie painted a lake sunrise in 2022; the painting is special to her.
Caroline thinks the colors in Melanie's lake sunrise painting blend nicely, and that painting looks like a great outlet for expressing oneself.
Melanie thinks painting is a fun way to express her feelings, get creative, and relax after a long day.
Caroline agrees with Melanie (Mel) that relaxing and expressing oneself is key.
After chatting on 2023-05-08, Caroline planned to go do some research.
Melanie believes taking care of ourselves is vital.
On 2023-05-08, Melanie planned to go swimming with her kids after chatting with Caroline.
On 2023-05-20, Melanie ran a charity race for mental health, which she found rewarding and thought-provoking.
Caroline told Melanie she was proud of Melanie for taking part in the charity race and for raising awareness for mental health.
Melanie told Caroline she is realizing that self-care is important, that it is a journey for her, and that when she looks after herself she is better able to look after her family.
Caroline agreed with Melanie that taking care of oneself is important, even if it is not always easy, and said it was great that Melanie is prioritizing self-care.
Melanie is carving out me-time each day by running, reading, or playing her violin; this refreshes Melanie and helps her stay present for her family.
Caroline told Melanie that Melanie is doing an awesome job looking after herself and Melanie's family.
Melanie said her self-care is still a work in progress, but she is doing her best.
Melanie's kids are excited about summer break.
Melanie and her kids are thinking about going camping in June 2023.
Melanie asked Caroline whether Caroline had any fun plans for the summer.
Caroline is researching adoption agencies as part of her dream to have a family and give a loving home to kids who need it.
Caroline's goal is to give kids a loving home; having a family through adoption has been a long-time dream of hers.
Melanie thinks Caroline is kind for taking in kids in need and says Caroline's future family will be lucky to have her.
Caroline is grateful for the support she has received from friends and mentors regarding her adoption plans, and says the hard work now starts to turn her dream into reality.

Caroline shared a photo of a sign for a new arrival and an information and domestic building, described as one of the adoption agencies she is looking into; she said it is a lot to take in but she feels hopeful and optimistic.
On 2023-05-25, Melanie commented that the adoption agency Caroline shared looked great and asked Caroline what made her pick it.
On 2023-05-25, Caroline said she chose her adoption agency because it helps LGBTQ+ people with adoption, and she said its inclusivity and support really spoke to her.
On 2023-05-25, Melanie told Caroline that was great and that she loved the inclusivity and support of Caroline's chosen adoption agency.
On 2023-05-25, Melanie asked Caroline what she is excited for in the adoption process; Caroline's answer is pending.
On 2023-05-25, Caroline told Melanie she is thrilled to make a family for kids who need one.
Caroline acknowledges that adopting and raising children as a single parent will be tough, but she is up for the challenge.
Melanie told Caroline that she is doing something amazing and will be an awesome mom, and wished her good luck with the adoption.
Caroline thanked Melanie, saying her kind words mean a lot, and promised to do her best to give the kids a safe and loving home.
Melanie told Caroline she has a caring heart and that the adopted kids will get all the love and stability they need, and said she is excited for Caroline's new chapter.

On 9 June 2023, Caroline told Melanie about a school event she had attended the previous week (around 2023-06-02), where she spoke about her transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community; she found it awesome and loved seeing the students' reactions.
Caroline started transitioning about three years before 9 June 2023 (around 2020).

Melanie told Caroline she was proud of her for spreading awareness and getting others involved in the LGBTQ community, and said Caroline has come a long way since her transition and should keep inspiring people with her strength and courage.

Caroline gave a talk at a school event (the week before 9 June 2023) in which she shared her own journey and struggles and how much she has developed since coming out; she felt super powerful giving the talk and was glad the audience related and were inspired to be better allies.

Caroline believes conversations about gender identity and inclusion are necessary and is thankful to be able to give a voice to the trans community; she feels sharing stories helps build a strong, supportive community of hope and promotes understanding and acceptance.

Melanie praised Caroline for doing an awesome job inspiring others, said talking about inclusivity and acceptance is crucial, and called Caroline brave for speaking up for the trans community (9 June 2023).
Melanie told Caroline that sharing our vulnerable stories bonds people and shows others they are not alone, and thanked Caroline for using her voice to create love, acceptance, and hope.
Caroline wants to keep using her voice to make change and lift others up, building a more inclusive and understanding world.
Caroline and Melanie (Mel) are close, mutually supportive friends who motivate and help each other and want to make a real impact together.
Melanie said she wants to be courageous for her family and that her family motivates her and gives her love.
Caroline says her friends, family, and mentors are her rocks — they motivate her and give her the strength to push on.
On 9 June 2023 Caroline shared a photo from when she met up with her friends/family the previous week (around 2023-06-02): a picture of a family posing together in a yard.
Melanie thinks Caroline's family photo (of a family posing in a yard) is great.

Caroline has known her friends for 4 years, since she moved from her home country (around 2019). Their love and help were especially important after a tough breakup. She is very thankful for her support system.
Melanie feels lucky to have her husband and kids; they keep her motivated.
Melanie shared a photo of a man and a little girl standing in front of a waterfall (likely her husband and daughter).
Melanie has been married for 5 years (as of 2023-06-09).
Melanie shared her wedding photo: a photo of a bride in a wedding dress holding a bouquet.
Melanie feels time flies and it feels like just yesterday she put on her wedding dress.
Caroline congratulated Melanie, said she and her husband looked great on their wedding day, and wished them many happy years together.
Melanie appreciated Caroline's kind words and is looking forward to more happy years with her husband; she believes family and moments make it all worth it.
Melanie shared a photo of a man and woman sitting on a blanket eating food (a family outing).
Melanie had a fun family day where they played games, ate good food, and hung out together.
Melanie believes family moments make life awesome.
Melanie cherishes time with family; it's when she really feels alive and happy.
Caroline agrees that hanging with loved ones is amazing and brings happiness; those moments make her thankful, and she believes family is everything.
On 2023-06-27 at 10:37 am, Caroline contacted Melanie after a long time and shared a photo of a person holding a necklace with a cross and a heart.

Caroline's necklace is a gift from her grandmother in Caroline's home country, Sweden. Her grandmother gave it to Caroline when Caroline was young; it symbolizes love, faith, and strength and reminds Caroline of her roots and the love and support she gets from her family.
On 2023-06-27, Melanie sent Caroline a photo of a stack of bowls with different designs and asked whether Caroline had other treasured objects.

Caroline owns a hand-painted bowl made by a friend as a gift for Caroline's 18th birthday about ten years before 2023, around 2013. The bowl's pattern and colors remind Caroline of art and self-expression.

During the week before 2023-06-27, approximately 2023-06-19 to 2023-06-25, Melanie took her family camping in the mountains. They explored nature, roasted marshmallows around a campfire, and went on a hike; the view from the top was amazing. Melanie's two younger kids love nature, and Melanie described the family time as special and unforgettable.
Melanie values family time and says family time matters to her.
Caroline told Melanie that family moments like Melanie's camping trip are special and said she was glad Melanie's family had a great time.
On 2023-06-27, Melanie asked Caroline what had been going on in Caroline's life lately.
Caroline is looking into counseling and mental health as a career because she wants to help people who have gone through the same things as her.
On 27 June 2023 Caroline shared a photo of a bookshelf with many books on it while discussing her counseling career interest.
Caroline is still figuring out details but plans to work in counseling with trans people, helping them accept themselves and supporting their mental health.

On Friday 23 June 2023, Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop that she found really enlightening; it covered different therapeutic methods and how to best work with trans people, and she was amazed by how passionate the professionals were about creating a safe space for people like her.
Melanie told Caroline that her dedication to helping others is impressive and inspiring, and asked what motivated her to pursue counseling.

Caroline's motivation for pursuing counseling comes from her own journey and the support she received; seeing how counseling and support groups improved her life made her care more about mental health and understanding herself, and she now wants to create a safe, inviting place for people to grow.

Melanie praised Caroline for gaining so much from her own experience and said her passion and hard work to help others is awesome and she is making a big impact; Caroline said Melanie's kind words mean a lot.
On 27 June 2023 Melanie congratulated Caroline on going after what she really cares about and shared a photo of a bookshelf filled with books in a room.

Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ pride parade in the week before 2023-07-03. Caroline felt happy and like she belonged; the parade showed Caroline how much the LGBTQ+ community has grown and Caroline found it amazing.
Melanie told Caroline that the LGBTQ+ pride parade sounded like an awesome experience; Melanie was glad to see love and support for the LGBTQ+ community and congratulated Caroline.

Caroline said the LGBTQ+ pride parade motivated her. Talking to the community made Caroline want to use Caroline's story to help others; Caroline is still thinking that counseling and mental health is the way to go and is excited to give back.

Melanie signed up for a pottery class on 2023-07-02. Melanie described pottery as therapy for her, letting her express herself and get creative. Melanie shared a photo of a person holding a frisbee in their hand.
Caroline is learning to play the piano and said Caroline is getting creative too. Caroline asked Melanie what made Melanie try pottery.
Melanie is a big fan of pottery; Melanie finds the creativity and skill awesome and making pottery calming. Melanie shared a photo of a bowl with a black and white flower design.
Caroline called Melanie's bowl gorgeous and said the black and white design looked fancy. Caroline asked Melanie if Melanie made it.
Melanie made the bowl with the black and white flower design in Melanie's pottery class. It took some work, and Melanie is pretty proud of it.
Caroline praised Melanie's pottery work, saying Melanie really put in the work and it shows; Caroline said Melanie's creativity looks great.
Melanie said pottery is a huge part of Melanie's life, not just a hobby; it helps Melanie express Melanie's emotions, and clay brings Melanie so much joy.
Caroline said Caroline is stoked that art helps Melanie express herself and brings Melanie joy, and Caroline encouraged Melanie to keep it up.
Melanie is excited to see where pottery takes Melanie and asked Caroline if anything upcoming Caroline is looking forward to.
Caroline plans to attend a transgender conference in July 2023. Caroline is excited to meet other people in the community and learn more about advocacy.
Melanie told Caroline to have a great time and learn a lot at the transgender conference, and told Caroline to have fun.
Caroline said Caroline cannot wait for the transgender conference and will keep Melanie posted about it.
Melanie said bye to Caroline. Melanie cannot wait to hear about Caroline's transgender conference and told Caroline to have fun and stay safe.
On 2023-07-06 at 8:18 pm, Caroline and Melanie talked after a long time; Melanie said she missed Caroline.
As of 2023-07-06, Caroline has been looking into counseling or mental health work more; she is passionate about helping people and making a positive impact, and finds the work tough but rewarding.
Melanie told Caroline that it was awesome and congratulated her on following her dreams.
On 2023-07-05, Melanie took her kids to a museum; she enjoyed spending time with them and seeing their eyes light up.
Melanie shared a photo with Caroline of two children playing in a water play area; Caroline called it a great pic and asked what the children were so excited about.
Melanie's children were excited about the dinosaur exhibit at the museum and love learning about animals; the cool bones reminded Melanie why she loves being a mom.
Caroline is creating a library for when she has kids; she looks forward to reading to them and opening up their minds. She shared a photo of a bookcase filled with books and toys.
Caroline's library for her future kids contains lots of kids' books, including classics, stories from different cultures, and educational books.
Melanie loved reading 'Charlotte's Web' as a child; she found it cool how friendship and compassion can make a difference. She shared a photo of a book cover with a picture of a girl and a cat.
Caroline shared a photo of a group of women sitting on a blanket in a park, from a picnic she had with friends and family the week before (around late June 2023).
Caroline says her friends' and family's support made her appreciate how lucky she is; they have helped with her transition and make all the difference.
Melanie called Caroline's picnic photo gorgeous and said the love around Caroline is awesome; she asked how friends and family have been helping with Caroline's transition.
Caroline describes her support network as amazing: they have been there every step of the way giving her love, guidance, and acceptance, and she says she couldn't have transitioned without them.
Caroline says her support system's love and encouragement helped her accept and grow into her true self and has been instrumental in her transition.
Melanie told Caroline it is great she has people to support her and that unconditional love is so important.
Melanie shared a photo of her family camping at the beach, sitting around a campfire; she said they love it and it brings them closer.
Melanie's family loves camping at the beach; she says it brings them closer together.
On 2023-07-10, Caroline attended an LGBTQ conference; she found it really special, welcoming, and felt totally accepted, and met and connected with people who had gone through similar journeys.
Caroline is thankful for the LGBTQ community and believes it is important to fight for trans rights and spread awareness.
Caroline believes having people who back you makes a huge difference; she thinks LGBTQ rights have come far but more progress is needed, and she wants to help make a difference.
As of 2023-07-12, Caroline is still looking into counseling and mental health jobs because she wants people to have someone to talk to and wants to help make that happen.
Caroline struggled with her mental health, and the support she received was really helpful; this made her realize how important it is for others to have a support system.
Caroline started looking into counseling and mental health career options so she could help other people on their own journeys, as she was helped.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie shared a photo of a book cover with a gold coin on it and said a book she read in 2022 reminds her to always pursue her dreams.
Caroline loves reading; books guide her, motivate her, and help her discover who she is, and they are a huge part of her journey.

Caroline's favorite guide book is "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt, an inspiring true story about a trans girl and her family; it made her feel connected and gave her hope for her own path, and she highly recommends it.
On 2023-07-12, Caroline shared a photo of a dog sitting in a boat on the water.
Caroline said "Becoming Nicole" taught her self-acceptance and how to find support; it also showed her that tough times don't last and that hope and love exist.
Caroline thinks pets bring so much joy.
Melanie agrees that self-acceptance and finding support are key, and that pets are awesome for joy and comfort.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie shared a photo of two little girls sitting on steps with a dog.
Melanie has two pets: a dog (pup) and a cat (kitty).
Melanie shared a photo of her cat lying on the floor with its head on the floor on 12 July 2023.
Caroline asked Melanie the names of her dog and cat on 12 July 2023.
Caroline finds Melanie's pets adorable and thinks pets bring joy.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie told Caroline that her pets are named Luna and Oliver; Melanie described Luna and Oliver as sweet and playful and said they liven up the house.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie shared a photo with Caroline of a person wearing pink sneakers on a white rug.
On 2023-07-12, Caroline commented that she loves the purple color of Melanie's new sneakers and asked whether they were for walking or running.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie said her new pink sneakers are for running and that she has been running longer since her last chat with Caroline.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie shared a photo with Caroline of a pair of pink sneakers in a box.
As of 2023-07-12, Melanie uses running as a way to destress and clear her mind, and running has been great for her headspace.
On 2023-07-12, Caroline told Melanie that running can boost mood and encouraged Melanie to keep running; Caroline said mental health is a priority and Melanie should take care of herself.
As of 2023-07-12, Melanie plans to keep running because it has greatly improved her mental health.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie thanked Caroline and said running has made such an improvement to her mental health, which is important to her.

On 2023-07-14, Melanie took her children to a pottery workshop where they each made their own pots; Melanie said it was fun and therapeutic and shared a photo of a group of children making clay sculptures in a classroom.
Melanie said her children loved the pottery workshop, were excited to get their hands dirty and make things with clay, and made a cup with a dog face; she shared a photo of the dog-face cup.
Caroline thought Melanie's children's dog-face cup was sweet and cute, and said it is awesome to see how kids show their personalities through art.
Melanie and her children love painting together lately, especially nature-inspired paintings.
On the weekend of 2023-07-08 to 2023-07-09, Melanie and her children painted a nature-inspired painting together; their latest work was a sunset with a palm tree, and Melanie shared a photo of it.

Melanie said she and her children both helped with the sunset palm tree painting, bonded over it, and chatted about nature; she also shared a photo of a field of purple flowers with green leaves and said they found the lovely flowers and appreciate the small things in life.
Caroline thought the sunset palm tree painting was amazing, with bold colors that highlighted the beauty of nature.

On 2023-07-14, Caroline attended a council meeting for adoption; it was inspiring and emotional, with many people wanting to create loving homes for children in need, and it made Caroline even more determined to adopt.
Caroline is determined to adopt a child.
Caroline and Melanie share a love of nature.
Caroline called Melanie's photo of a field of purple flowers stunning and was glad Melanie bonded with her children over nature.
On 2023-07-15, Melanie shared a photo of a blue vase with a bouquet of sunflowers and roses and asked Caroline what she thought of it.
Melanie told Caroline that Caroline's future family will get a kick out of having Caroline.
Caroline said her favorite color is blue and that blue makes her feel relaxed, after seeing Melanie's photo of a blue vase on 2023-07-15.
Caroline believes sunflowers symbolize warmth and happiness, while roses symbolize love and beauty.
Caroline asked Melanie what flowers mean to her during their 2023-07-15 conversation.
Melanie says flowers bring joy, represent growth and beauty, and remind her to appreciate small moments; flowers were an important part of her wedding decor and remind her of her wedding day.
Melanie shared a photo of a row of white chairs decorated with flowers, related to her wedding decor, on 2023-07-15.
Caroline told Melanie she wished she had known Melanie back then, referring to Melanie's wedding.

Melanie described her wedding as amazing, full of love and joy, with everyone Melanie and her partner loved there to celebrate them; she shared a photo of a wedding ceremony in a greenhouse with people taking pictures. Melanie married her partner around 2018.
Caroline asked Melanie what her favorite part of her wedding was.
Melanie said the best part of her wedding was marrying her partner and promising to be together forever; she shared a photo of a man and woman standing on a beach.

Caroline attended a Pride parade a few weeks before 2023-07-15, around June/July 2023, and joined in; she shared photos of a parade with people walking down the street, a group holding up signs and smiling, a rainbow flag on a pole on a carpet, and a group sitting on the ground with a dog.

Caroline felt accepted, happy, proud, and grateful at the Pride parade; she said the vibes were amazing, it was comforting to know she is not alone and has a great community, and being around people who embrace and back her up was beyond words and inspired her.

Caroline said the best part of the Pride experience was realizing she can be herself without fear and having the courage to transition; it felt freeing to express herself authentically and have people back her up.

Melanie, calling Caroline 'Caro', told Caroline that finding the courage to be herself is important for mental health and finding peace; Melanie shared a photo of a Buddha statue and a candle on a table.
Melanie said she is getting there in finding peace, and that creativity and family keep her at peace; she shared a photo of a man holding a frisbee in front of a frisbee golf basket.
Caroline asked Melanie how her family had been supportive during her move; Melanie said her family was awesome, helped out, and showed lots of love and support.
Caroline said family love and support is the best.

Melanie said her family's love and support helped her through tough times and that they went on another camping trip in the forest; she shared a photo of a man and two children sitting around a campfire.
Caroline shared a photo of a family walking through a forest with a toddler while asking Melanie what else Melanie's family likes doing together.
Melanie shared a photo of a girl sitting in a teepee with stuffed animals during the 2023-07-15 conversation.
Caroline shared a photo of a teepee with a teddy bear and pillows during the 2023-07-15 conversation.
Melanie and her family enjoy hiking in the mountains and exploring forests as a way to connect with nature and each other.
Caroline thinks that exploring nature and family time is special.
Melanie says that hiking and exploring nature with her family are some of her favourite memories, bringing them together and happiness.
Melanie is glad that Caroline is there to share in her family memories.
Caroline is glad to have Melanie as a friend to share her journey.
Caroline thinks Melanie is awesome.
Melanie appreciates Caroline's friendship and says it's great to have a supporter.
Caroline says that Melanie's friendship means so much to her.
On the weekend of 8-9 July 2023, Melanie went camping with her family and enjoyed unplugging and hanging out with her kids.
On the weekend of 15-16 July 2023, Melanie had a quiet weekend after the family camping trip.
On the weekend of 15-16 July 2023, Caroline joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth, finding it rewarding to help the community.
Caroline finds mentoring LGBTQ youth rewarding and inspiring, especially seeing how resilient and strong the young people are.
Caroline mentors a transgender teenager who is like her; they work on building confidence and positive strategies, and it has been paying off.
Caroline and her transgender teen mentee get along well; Melanie was glad to hear it.
In June 2023, Caroline and her transgender teen mentee attended an LGBT pride event; Caroline was encouraged by the love and acceptance around them.
On 17 July 2023, Caroline shared a photo of a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air, referring to the June 2023 LGBT pride event.
The best part of the June 2023 LGBT pride event for Caroline was seeing her transgender teen mentee's face light up when the mentee saw the support.
Melanie thinks it is awesome to see the difference people can make in each other's lives through LGBTQ advocacy and mentorship.
Melanie asked Caroline whether any other exciting LGBTQ advocacy events were coming up.
Caroline is having an LGBTQ art show in August 2023 featuring her paintings.
Melanie shared a photo of a painting with a blue and yellow design.
Melanie thinks Caroline's upcoming LGBTQ art show sounds awesome and is eager to see her art.
Caroline shared a photo of her painting for the LGBTQ art show: a painting of a tree with a bright sun in the background.
Caroline's painting for the LGBTQ art show depicts a tree with a bright sun in the background.
Melanie thinks Caroline's painting of a tree with a bright sun is awesome, with vivid colors and a unified look.
Caroline painted her tree-with-sun painting after visiting an LGBTQ center; she wanted to capture everyone's unity and strength.
Melanie thinks Caroline's painting conveys unity and strength and calls it a gorgeous piece.
Melanie and her kids finished another painting, similar to their last one.
On 2023-07-18, Caroline joined a new LGBTQ activist group called 'Connected LGBTQ Activists'.

Caroline finds her new LGBTQ activist group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists', fulfilling; she is meeting many cool people passionate about rights and community support and feels she is giving her voice and making a real difference.
'Connected LGBTQ Activists' is made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes; the group has regular meetings and plans events and campaigns to support each other.
On 2023-07-15..2023-07-16, Caroline's city held a pride parade with many people marching through the streets waving flags and holding signs, celebrating love and diversity. Caroline missed it.
Caroline said the missed city pride parade was a powerful reminder that they are not alone in the fight for equality and inclusivity, and that change is possible.
Melanie recently went to the beach with her kids; the kids had a blast. Melanie shared a photo of three children playing on the beach with a kite.
On 2023-07-20, Caroline asked Melanie what the best part of Melanie's recent beach trip was and whether Melanie does it often with the kids.
Melanie said Caroline's LGBTQ activist group sounds awesome and inspiring and that it must feel great for Caroline to speak her truth and stand up for what's right.

Melanie shared a photo of a sand castle on the beach under a blue sky, saying seeing her kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best; her family doesn't go often, usually only once or twice a year, but those times are always special for spending time together and chilling.
Melanie's family goes to the beach only once or twice a year; she considers those trips always special and a time to spend together and chill.
Caroline asked Melanie whether her family has any other summer traditions they all do together, encouraging her to create those memories.

Melanie's family always looks forward to their annual family camping trip — a summer highlight — where they roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and enjoy each other's company. She shared a photo of a fire pit with a lot of fire and sparks.

Melanie's best camping memory is her family's camping trip last year when they saw the Perseid meteor shower; lying there watching the sky light up with streaks of light was amazing, they all made wishes and felt at one with the universe, a memory she'll never forget. She shared a photo of a plane flying in a star-filled sky.

On 2023-07-20 at 8:56 pm, Melanie told Caroline about seeing a clear sky filled with stars and an amazing meteor shower, which made Melanie feel part of something huge and awe-inspiring; Melanie shared a photo of a plane flying in the sky with a trail of smoke.
Caroline thought Melanie's meteor shower memory must have been breathtaking and responded with amazement.

On 2023-07-20, Melanie described feeling tiny and in awe of the universe during the starry/meteor shower moment and said it reminded Melanie how awesome life is, full of little moments; Melanie shared a photo of a beach with footprints in the sand and a blue sky.
On 2023-07-20, Caroline asked Melanie what other good memories make Melanie feel thankful for life.

Melanie said Melanie will never forget the day Melanie's youngest daughter took her first steps; seeing Melanie's youngest daughter wobble through those initial steps made Melanie think about how fleeting life is and how lucky Melanie is to share such moments.

On 2023-07-20, Caroline called Melanie's memory of Melanie's youngest daughter's first steps sweet and said such milestones remind Caroline how special bonds are; Caroline shared a photo of a baby in a white crib with a blue blanket.

Caroline called Melanie's family beach sunset moment beautiful and said Melanie is lucky to have such an awesome family.
Melanie thanked Caroline and said Melanie feels lucky to have Melanie's family, who bring Melanie so much joy and love.

The concert Melanie attended on 13 August 2023 for her daughter's birthday was by Matt Patterson; Melanie thinks he is very talented and found his voice and songs amazing.
Caroline attended an advocacy event recently (as of 14 August 2023) which she described as a cool experience with so much love and support, amazing.
Caroline shared a photo of a concert poster featuring a picture of a man, in the chat on 14 August 2023.

Melanie shared a photo of a band performing on stage with a sign that says 'all are welcome', on 14 August 2023.

Caroline shared a photo of a group of people walking down a street with balloons from the pride parade, showing people of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance; she said it pushed her to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.

Melanie shared a photo of a group of people sitting on chairs watching a band, taken at the concert the night before (13 August 2023); the picture looked like everyone was having a blast and reminded her it's important to cultivate a loving and accepting environment for their kids.
Caroline says representing inclusivity and diversity in her art is important to her, and she uses her art to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and push for acceptance.
Caroline shared a photo of a recent painting of hers, showing a painting brush and paint on it, on 14 August 2023.
Caroline praised Melanie's love for her kids as awesome, and Melanie said she is thankful for their special family moments.
Melanie asked Caroline how she stays inclusive in her work as an artist; Caroline explained she represents inclusivity and diversity in her art and uses it for LGBTQ+ advocacy.
Melanie asked Caroline about the main idea of her art.
Caroline's art is about expressing her trans experience, showing her story and helping people understand the trans community.
Caroline shared a photo of a painting of a woman with a cow in her lap.
Melanie thinks Caroline's art is amazing, loves how she uses it to tell stories and teach people about trans folks, and would love to see another painting.
Melanie shared a photo of a person holding a purple bowl in their hand.

Caroline's painting 'Embracing Identity' is about finding comfort and love in being yourself; the woman in the painting stands for the journey of acceptance; its aim is to show warmth, love, and self-acceptance.
